name: Pollinations
short: Open AI infrastructure with a permanently free, no-signup API for text and image generation, rate-limited per IP; API keys unlock every model and higher limits.

plans.name: Free (no signup)
plans.notes: Classic API needs no key: text is rate-limited to one request at least 30 s apart per IP (images 45 s). Best-effort, no uptime guarantee.

plans.name: API key (Enter)
plans.notes: Your own key from enter.pollinations.ai removes the per-IP limit and unlocks every image, text, audio and video model; start with free pollen from quests and buy more when needed.

plans.name: Per-request
plans.notes: Agent wallets can pay per request via x402 (USDC on Base, via Weft); the 402 response carries the payment details.
